title: Google satellite AI server sends its first response to Earth
excerpt: Google successfully boots up an AI chip-equipped satellite, allowing its on-board Gemma 4 model to generate a haiku from space.
body_html:
Google has successfully tested an AI server in space, with its satellite's on-board chips generating and transmitting a response back to Earth.

According to a blog post, Google booted up the satellite's Tensor Processing Units, enabling the on-board Gemma 4 model to process a prompt while in orbit. The system successfully followed through on the request to compose a haiku about being in space, marking a milestone for running artificial intelligence models directly on hardware in orbit.
